description:
What is This Part?
This is the Sending Unit that goes inside the Carburated and EFI fuel tanks.
It measures the amount of fuel left in the tank and then sends that signal to the Fuel Meter
If the fuel gauge is not working then replacing this part usually fixes it.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 Sending Unit
Qty 1 Gasket for Sending Unit
Sending Unit is the same manufacturer as OEM – branded Pricol
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
